notes: v480 — the lessons now teach what each signal MEANS without printing the exact number that fires it. The security review found eleven of your fifteen triggers written out in plain English, so moving the code to the server had protected the workings but left the recipe published in the teaching. Textbook numbers stay — RSI 30, the 50/200 golden cross, the 200-day average — because everyone already knows those and removing them would only cost you readers. What's gone is the tuned judgement: how far above average, how many days, and the Watch Score's multipliers. Nothing was deleted; every passage was rewritten, and the Watch Score now points you at the app's own per-share working instead. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
